messages:
Marta: dropping a short-form RN draft for the host-model push. Need pin for model-server v2.3.1 (hotfix). Stage-gate in 14:00 PT window. Can owners ack pin + rollout cadence?
Ibrahim: read it  sounds good. Please pin as `v2.3.1-hotfix-2024-06` so dashboard filters straight away.
Noah: I can handle the pin and the deploybot trigger. Prefer a *quick* canary: 3% for 5m -> 30% for 7m -> 100%. Adds KV-cache warmup before each step.
Priya: RN note: "fixes intermittent long-tail latency for multi-chunk prompts; mitigates tokenization drift on edge clients." Add rollback steps: revert to v2.3.0 + disable experimental tokenizer flag.
SRE Oncall: Confirmed change window 13:45-14:45. I'll set alert: p95 > 300ms OR 5xx >= 0.8% for 4m => notify #incident-deploy and page.
deploy-bot: queued deploy job 86020 | env=prod | image=model-server:v2.3.1 | strategy=canary(3%,5m)->30%(7m)->100% | requested_by=Noah | pin_label=v2.3.1-hotfix-2024-06
Noah: running dry-run at 13:55 PT: `deploybot trigger 86020 --dry-run`. If dry-run green, scheduled rollout at 14:00 PT. I'll publish an internal note after dry-run.
Marta: updated RN with rollback snippet and exact alert thresholds. Preview: https://redwood.internal/rn/1719550000 (internal-only)
Priya: whos on hotfix dev standby if rollback has DB migration hiccups? @Ibrahim + @SRE Oncall?
Ibrahim: standing by with a DB migration revert plan. Also have migration logs ready.
SRE Oncall: confirmed standby + will open incident channel on alert.
deploy-bot: job 86020 dry-run passed at 13:56. ready for scheduled rollout at 14:00.
Noah: posting internal announce now: "Starting canary rollout for model-server v2.3.1-hotfix-2024-06 at 14:00 PT. Canary steps: 3%->30%->100%. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Ibrahim @Marta."
Marta: please pin the RN to #eng-releases and add changelog entry with the pin label.
Noah: triggered rollout.
deploy-bot: job 86020 status: canary(3%) started at 14:00.
Priya: observing metrics: initial 3m looks ok, token coldstart spike resolved after cache warmup.
deploy-bot: job 86020 status: canary(30%) started at 14:06.
SRE Oncall: running checks, no sustained error rates. p95 stable. Green to proceed to full rollout in 7m unless someone objects.
Noah: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: job 86020 status: 100% started at 14:14. job 86020 status: success at 14:18.
Marta: RN finalized, pinned, changelog updated. I'll close the thread after posting the internal digest.
Ibrahim: nice work team. Closing.
